mechanism: Leflunomide is teratogenic and may reduce levonorgestrel efficacy through hepatic enzyme induction via its active metabolite A77 1726, potentially compromising contraceptive reliability.
action: Use alternative contraception or highly effective non-hormonal methods; if hormonal contraception is necessary, consider higher-dose formulations and counsel on backup contraception during leflunomide therapy and 2-year washout period.
